chunks: And with this chain of narrators, from Sufyan al-Jariri, that he said: I heard Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Laila say:
By Allah, the Mahdi will not be, except from the progeny of Husain (peace be upon him).

key_terms.الْحُسَيْنِ: Imam Husain, the grandson of the Prophet Muhammad
key_terms.الْمَهْدِيُّ: The Mahdi, the expected savior and leader

ai.seo_question: Who is the Mahdi descended from according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Sufan al-Jariri highlights the exclusive lineage of the Mahdi through Imam Husain (a.s), distinguishing the Twelfth Imam from other potential claimants and reinforcing the concept of *Nass* (designation) within Shia theology. It underscores the historical continuity of the Imamate, linking the final savior directly to the progeny of the Prophet through Husain, thereby validating the Alid claim to leadership. This assertion is central to the doctrine of the Occultation (*Ghayba*), as it confirms the Mahdi's identity despite his long absence.
